regions.merged_text: The New Year is still in its baby-hood: so I'll wish you all kinds of blessings before it passes as all others so far have gone. If ever I get up with my letters again I'll write to my dear ones more frequently. I hope. .I am glad you have found someone and that someone has found you wherecy mutual congeniality seems promising. .That he is older than you is a secondary matter. Even that he actually knows little about the True Religion might be secondary too, if only he or anyone else be desirous to learn - be willing to find out - and dispel doubts .. .It is so easy for the Church to vindicate her every Doctrine! !!.. . How your dear Father John was convinced of this! So much so that tho his death was tragic, it was never the less a holy death. I never worried about that.
